listing.name: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (FFTA Recomp)
listing.summary: Add a prepared FFTA Recomp copy for your own supported USA GBA ROM.

steps.title: Start with the complete package
steps.instruction: Keep the complete package for your system together. Observe the project’s applicable noncommercial terms.

steps.title: Use your own supported USA original
steps.instruction: Keep your own Final Fantasy Tactics Advance USA GBA ROM (AFXE), expected SHA-1 4ac05441f4de70a4ec3dd932116346c61b8783d9. The inspected source performs a final runtime hash rejection after the permissive file picker. The package includes the separately licensed clean-room emibios replacement; no Nintendo BIOS dump is required. Complete the normal upstream first selection/setup outside Portcove and keep game.toml, bios/, resources and existing original paths together.

steps.title: Attach the actual native player
steps.instruction: Select FFTARecomp.exe (on Linux, the FFTARecomp AppImage) with its complete creating package directory as working directory and no extra arguments for the normal in-process launch screen. The inspected title runs that screen and game in the same process; it does not hand the game to a detached launcher. Retain only the supported literal arguments your working setup actually requires, including existing --save/--save-path and --state-dir choices. Do not select a tool or start a separate compiler/helper.

steps.title: Review launch details, then choose Play
steps.instruction: Review and consent to this exact native executable, working directory and literal arguments, then choose Play separately. Upstream and you own preparation, replacement and recovery of external files. Removing registration preserves every external file. Close the actual player before upstream maintenance; retain old runtime/data and review/relink changed selected bytes.

warnings: Keep every effective external file and custom root with its creating runtime. Portcove offers no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion.

This upstream preview is experimental. Source and package descriptions and static checks do not confirm that the package matches the source or that gameplay, normal shutdown, saves or installed Desktop behavior work. Other platforms have separate requirements.
Do not assume all states live beside the player or in states/.
No cross-version state/save compatibility or managed backup is claimed.
The package includes retail box art of unknown provenance that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Preserve saves and all effective external roots
references.instruction: The inspected game.toml uses saves/ffta_us.sav relative to its own directory for the 64KiB battery save. Existing --save or --save-path overrides can point elsewhere. Save-state slots normally live beside the actual selected ROM with .stateN names; --state-dir moves those basenames to the chosen directory. Do not assume all states live beside the player or in states/. Preserve your ROM directory and its state/sidecar files, actual custom save/state directories, the complete creating runtime, saves/, rom.cfg, bios.cfg, skip_launcher_on_boot, config.ini, keybinds.ini, game.toml, config overlays, mods, screenshots, logs, backups and temporary files. No cross-version state/save compatibility or managed backup is claimed.
